description: This file is a shell script that manages network interface configurations, Wi-Fi access points, IP address setups, Web UI configurations, bridge settings, and services restart for a device operating in bridge mode. It automates various network setup and teardown tasks related to Wi-Fi interfaces, bridge management, and service control.

methods.name: Restart_Hostapd
methods.description: Restarts the hostapd process and resets network interfaces related to wlan0 and wlan0_0.
